title: 第25章 出剑第26章 生死瞬间
content_zh:
柳乘风微微一愣，“什么是元力变奏？”
柳千灯眼神一闪，目光盯着余烬手上释放的元力，“一种适合低境界使用的攻击法门，它能通过改变元力的流动方式和节奏，让元力强度释放得更加精准、凝练和强大，只是此法门早已在荒州失传多年！”
演武台上，余峰身影狠狠地砸落地上，荒石做的场地地板发出轰隆作响声，他怎么也没有想到明明服用了沸血丹，他的元力强度近乎媲美四境前期，可却还是这么不堪一击！
更可恶的是对面的余烬还只是个元海境！
“不可能……怎么可能！！”余峰挣扎想站起来，刚刚抬头却发现一双黑眸淡淡地看着他。
余烬缓缓抬起脚掌，面无表情问道：“你的底牌真让人失望。”
余山海开口喝止，“余烬，你已经赢了，给我个面子，放了余峰！”
面对着那双仿佛深渊地狱一般的黑色眼眸，余峰心底忽然一寒，死亡的恐惧涌上心头，慌忙说道：“余烬，你放过我一次，我以后不会再和你做对……”
余峰还想说继续求饶下去，只是余烬脸色平静，一脚踏在了他胸膛之上！
咔嚓！
骨头断裂的声音，清晰地传遍每个一角落，余峰眼睛大睁，瞳孔中的生机迅速消散！
“余烬！”余山海脸色猛地阴沉下去，“你做得太绝了！”
余烬转过身，没有丝毫惧意地看着余山海，“生死斗，不是他死就是我死，还让我给你面子，你是个白痴吗？！”
“你！”余山海双眉倒竖，气得长袍舞动，“好好好，我今日便要教教你尊卑不分的下场是什么！”
嘭！
满脸震怒的余山海身影一下原地消失，等他再度出现时不仅出现在台上，更是来到了余烬三尺之内，凌空便是一掌朝着后者的天灵盖压下！
那个刹那，余山海手掌凝聚出一个气息恐怖的元力球，演武台上仿佛山呼海啸，一股强横无比的威压将余烬牢牢锁定在原地！
不少人同时心中一惊，谁也没想到余山海会在暴怒下突然下手，而且那股恐怖的波动之强，显然根本没有给余烬活下来的打算！
柳家众人脸上闪过冷笑，李道麟一动不动，作为这次会武主持者的余重三更是端坐在铁椅上面无表情！
所有都觉得余烬死定了！

可偏偏就在余山海的手掌即将拍中余烬之时，这片空间响起一道奇异的震动声，一对如梦似幻的蝶翼展开，拖动摇曳着瑰丽无比的七彩流光！
余小蝶的身影拦在了俩人之间！
“御·七彩蝶茧！”余小蝶轻喝一声，身后的蝶翼轻轻扇动，周围的空间流速仿佛开始变得无比缓慢，七色的光芒流转，形成一个防御茧将她与余烬护在身前。
余山海一掌打在了七彩茧上，余小蝶的娇躯一震，七彩茧应声裂开，蝶翼再动，一股强横无匹的七彩流光，将余山海击退！
此时，余小蝶那绝美的五官充满冷冽，“我哥，也是你能动的！？”
众人心中一惊，余山海脸上更是写满了意外，他刚才那一击虽然未用全力，可哪怕一个寻常四境后期都未必懒得下，而余小蝶似乎才入四境不久！
“不愧是被余氏族山看中的超级天才，居然能拦下五境一击，那对翅膀是兵器……还是道种显化……”李道麟来了兴致，不由看向余重三。
content_en:
Liu Chengfeng was slightly startled, "What is Yuanli Variation?"
Liu Qiandeng's eyes flashed and he stared at the Yuan Power released from Yi Yan's hand, "An attack method suitable for low-level use. It can change the flow and rhythm of Yuan Power to make the release of Yuan Power more precise, condensed and powerful. However, this method has been lost in Huangzhou for many years!"
On the martial arts stage, Yu Feng's figure hit the ground hard, and the floor of the venue made of wild rocks made a rumbling sound. He never thought that even though he had taken the Boiling Blood Pill, his Yuanli strength was almost as strong as that of the early stage of the Four Realms, but he was still so vulnerable!
What's even more disgusting is that the ember on the opposite side is only in the Yuanhai realm!
"Impossible...how is it possible!!" Yu Feng struggled to stand up, but just when he raised his head, he found a pair of black eyes looking at him faintly.
Ember slowly raised his feet and asked expressionlessly: "Your trump card is really disappointing."
Yu Shanhai started to shout, "Yi Yan, you have already won, give me some face and let Yu Feng go!"
Facing those black eyes that looked like an abyss of hell, Yu Feng suddenly felt a chill in his heart. The fear of death surged into his heart, and he hurriedly said: "Ember, please let me go once, I will never go against you again..."
Yu Feng wanted to continue begging for mercy, but Yi Yan looked calm and stepped on his chest!
Click!
The sound of bones breaking clearly spread to every corner. Yu Feng's eyes widened, and the life in his pupils quickly dissipated!
"Ember!" Yu Shanhai's face suddenly darkened, "You did an incredible job!"
Yi Yan turned around and looked at Yu Shanhai without any fear, "In a life-or-death fight, either he dies or I die, and you ask me to give you face, are you an idiot?!"
"You!" Yu Shanhai raised his eyebrows, his robe fluttering in anger, "Okay, okay, today I'm going to teach you what the consequences are if you don't distinguish between superior and inferior!"
Bang!
Yu Shanhai, whose face was full of anger, disappeared on the spot. When he reappeared, he not only appeared on the stage, but also came within three feet of the ember, and pressed down the latter's Tianling Cap with a palm from the air!
At that moment, Yu Shanhai condensed a ball of Yuanli with a terrifying aura in his palm. The martial arts stage felt like a roaring mountain and a tsunami, and an extremely powerful pressure locked the ember firmly in place!
Many people were shocked at the same time. No one expected that Yu Shanhai would suddenly attack in a rage, and the terrifying wave was so strong that he obviously had no intention of letting Yu Yan survive!
Sneers flashed across the faces of everyone in the Liu family, Li Daolin remained motionless, and Yu Zhongsan, who was the host of this martial arts competition, was sitting on the iron chair with no expression on his face!
Everyone feels that Ember is dead!
But just when Yu Shanhai's palm was about to hit the ember, a strange vibration sounded in the space, and a pair of dreamlike butterfly wings spread out, dragging and swaying a magnificent colorful stream of light!
Yu Xiaodie's figure stood between the two of them!
"Yu·Colorful Butterfly Cocoon!" Yu Xiaodie shouted softly, and the butterfly wings behind her flapped slightly. The flow of space around her seemed to become extremely slow, and the seven-color light flowed, forming a defensive cocoon to protect her and Ember in front of her.
Yu Shanhai hit the colorful cocoon with a palm, and Yu Xiaodie's delicate body shook. The colorful cocoon split open, and the butterfly wings moved again, and a powerful and unparalleled colorful stream of light drove Yu Shanhai away!
At this time, Yu Xiaodie's beautiful facial features were full of coldness, "You can also move my brother!?"
Everyone was shocked, and Yu Shanhai's face was full of surprise. Although he didn't use all his strength in the attack just now, even an ordinary late-stage Fourth Realm person might not be too lazy to strike, and Yu Xiaodie seemed to have just entered the Fourth Realm not long ago!
"As expected of a super genius who was favored by Yu Clan Mountain, he was able to block a strike from the Five Realms. Are those wings weapons... or the manifestation of Tao seed..." Li Daolin became interested and couldn't help but look at Yu Zhongsan.
